text: The '绿城 / GREENTOWN' (Greentown) sponsorship of Zhejiang FC is by Greentown China Holdings Limited: Qianjiang Evening News reported in February 2025 that the club had agreed with Greentown China to compete under the 'Greentown' naming ('浙江职业足球俱乐部绿城队', short '浙江俱乐部绿城') from the 2025 season, and the club announced in March 2026 that Greentown's naming continues for the 2026 season.
short: The 'Greentown' naming/shirt sponsorship is Greentown China Holdings.

source.name: 钱江晚报·潮新闻 via Sohu: 谁的青春回来了？绿城冠名浙江队，新赛季以“浙江俱乐部绿城”征战中超
source.quote: 近日，浙江职业足球俱乐部与绿城中国协商，由浙江省足球协会审核并报浙江省体育局
source.note: Translation: 'Recently, Zhejiang Professional Football Club negotiated with Greentown China Holding[s]; reviewed by the Zhejiang FA and reported to the Zhejiang sports bureau...' The article reports the club would compete under the naming '浙江俱乐部绿城' (Zhejiang Club Greentown) from the 2025 season.

additionalSources.name: 懂球帝 (Dongqiudi) via Baijiahao: 依旧“浙江绿城”，浙江队新赛季继续由绿城冠名
additionalSources.quote: 绿城继续冠名浙江队，第29年
additionalSources.note: Translation: 'Greentown continues to title [name] Zhejiang team, the 29th year.' Reports the club's official announcement that Greentown continues as naming sponsor for the 2026 season.
